commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
  listado -e C0_ANVL_PREVCLOSE_BONDS | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -c Pc_MultiSource_Bonds_PrevClose -t 070000 -
  listado -e C0_ANVL_PREVCLOSE_BONDS | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -c Pc_MultiSource_Bonds_PrevClose_IPV -t 070000 -
else
  listado -e C0_ANVL_PREVCLOSE_BONDS | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -d $BusinessDate -c Pc_MultiSource_Bonds_PrevClose -t 070000 -
  listado -e C0_ANVL_PREVCLOSE_BONDS | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -d $BusinessDate -c Pc_MultiSource_Bonds_PrevClose_IPV -t 070000 -
fi
jobDescription: This is a command execution job! It executes a script and possible has some parameters passed to it.
